findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: why_competitor_wins · Private data: agent_test, scan_visibility, test_company_for_ai, who_ai_recommends, roast_my_website, why_competitor_wins · Public sink: agent_test, who_ai_recommends · Destructive: agent_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: why_competitor_wins · Private data: agent_test, scan_visibility, test_company_for_ai, who_ai_recommends, roast_my_website, why_competitor_wins · Public sink: agent_test, who_ai_recommends · Destructive: agent_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
